countries.name: Singapore
countries.tagline: A city that runs on order, and somehow still surprises you.
countries.intro: My first stop into Southeast Asia — and the easiest place to fall for. Hawker centres, glass towers, and rainforest, all inside one MRT ride.

places.name: Marina Bay & the Downtown Core
places.note: Skyline walks, the Merlion at sunrise, and a rooftop that made me rethink what a city view could look like.

places.name: Tiong Bahru & Chinatown
places.note: Old shophouses, kopi in a real coffeeshop, and the best plate of chilli crab I've had anywhere.

places.name: Sentosa & Southern Islands
places.note: A short cable car ride out of the CBD chaos into beach clubs and quiet coastline.

logistics.stay: Capsule hotel, Bugis — clean, central, budget-friendly
logistics.transport: EZ-Link card on the MRT the entire trip — no car needed

tickets.name: Scoot — MNL to SIN
tickets.note: Booked ~6 weeks out for the best fare

tickets.name: Bugis Capsule Hotel
tickets.note: Booked via Booking.com

tickets.name: EZ-Link Card
tickets.note: Top up at any MRT station

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.tagline: Petronas lights, jungle air, and a food scene that never lets up.
countries.intro: KL was meant to be a two-day layover. It turned into a full week between the Batu Caves, the Cameron Highlands tea fields, and Penang's street art.

places.name: Kuala Lumpur
places.note: KLCC Park at golden hour, Batu Caves before the tour buses arrive, and Jalan Alor at night for the satay.

places.name: Cameron Highlands
places.note: A road trip up into tea plantations and strawberry farms — the temperature drop alone is worth it.

places.name: Penang (George Town)
places.note: Street art alleys, colonial shophouses, and hands-down the best char kway teow of the whole trip.

logistics.stay: Mix of hostels (KL) and a homestay (Cameron Highlands)
logistics.transport: Rented a car for the highlands leg — Grab everywhere else
logistics.best_time: Year-round, avoid Nov–Dec monsoon on the east coast

tickets.name: AirAsia — SIN to KUL
tickets.note: Book the early morning flight, cheaper + less turbulence

tickets.name: Perodua Axia, self-drive
tickets.note: Picked up at KL Sentral, dropped in Ipoh

tickets.name: Cameron Highlands homestay
tickets.note: Found via Agoda, mountain view room

countries.name: Thailand
countries.tagline: Temples at dawn, night markets at midnight, islands in between.
countries.intro: Three weeks, three regions — Bangkok's chaos, Chiang Mai's calm, and the islands down south. Still the trip I recommend to every first-time backpacker.

places.name: Bangkok
places.note: Wat Arun across the river at sunset, Chatuchak on a Saturday, and a rooftop bar that made the humidity worth it.

places.name: Chiang Mai & Pai
places.note: Rented a scooter and did the Pai loop over two days — waterfalls, canyon views, and the best banana pancakes on the route.

places.name: Koh Lipe & Koh Phi Phi
places.note: Island hopping by longtail boat, snorkeling off Maya Bay before the crowds arrived at 8am.

logistics.flights: Bangkok internal legs via Thai Lion Air + a ferry from Krabi to the islands
logistics.stay: Hostels in BKK & Chiang Mai, beach bungalow on Koh Lipe
logistics.transport: Scooter rental in the north, longtail boats in the south
logistics.best_time: Nov–Feb, dry season across the whole country

tickets.name: Thai Lion Air — BKK to Krabi
tickets.note: Booked last-minute, still under $40

tickets.name: Honda Click 125i
tickets.note: Rented in Pai, 300 THB/day incl. helmet

tickets.name: Krabi → Koh Lipe speedboat
tickets.note: 2.5h, book the morning departure

countries.name: Philippines
countries.tagline: Home base, and still the trip that surprises me every time.
countries.intro: 7,000+ islands and I've barely made a dent. These are the routes I keep coming back to — and sending friends on.

places.name: Palawan (El Nido & Coron)
places.note: Island-hopping tours A to D, hidden lagoons, and a shipwreck dive in Coron that's still my favourite in the country.

places.name: Siargao
places.note: Learned to surf at Cloud 9, rented a motorbike for the island loop, and the rock pools at Magpupungko at low tide.

places.name: Batanes
places.note: The furthest north I've travelled at home — rolling hills, stone houses, and almost no phone signal. Worth every peso.

logistics.flights: Manila → Puerto Princesa / Siargao / Basco, all direct on Cebu Pacific
logistics.stay: Budget guesthouses + one splurge resort night in El Nido
logistics.transport: Habal-habal and rented scooters on every island

tickets.name: Cebu Pacific — MNL to Basco
tickets.note: Limited seats, book 2 months ahead

tickets.name: El Nido Island Hopping Tour A
tickets.note: Booked through the hostel, split cost with 4 others

tickets.name: Honda Beat, Siargao
tickets.note: 300 PHP/day, ask at Cloud 9 area

countries.name: Vietnam
countries.tagline: A country you cross by motorbike, one coastline at a time.
countries.intro: North to south, mostly on two wheels. Hanoi's old quarter, Ha Long Bay by boat, and a coastal ride I still think about.

places.name: Hanoi & Ha Long Bay
places.note: Egg coffee in the Old Quarter, then an overnight boat through the limestone karsts of Ha Long Bay.

places.name: Hoi An & Da Nang
places.note: Lantern-lit old town at night, a tailored jacket I still wear, and the Marble Mountains just outside the city.

places.name: Ho Chi Minh City
places.note: War Remnants Museum, the Bến Thành night market, and rooftop pho that broke every rule I thought pho had.

logistics.flights: Manila → Hanoi (Cebu Pacific), then domestic hops on Vietjet
logistics.stay: Hostels + one homestay near Hoi An
logistics.transport: Motorbike rented in Hoi An for the coastal stretch
logistics.best_time: Feb–Apr for the whole north-to-south route

tickets.name: Vietjet — HAN to DAD
tickets.note: Domestic leg, booked a week ahead

tickets.name: Ha Long Bay overnight cruise
tickets.note: Mid-range operator, booked via hostel desk

tickets.name: Honda Wave, Hoi An to Hue
tickets.note: One-way rental, drop-off included

countries.name: Maldives
countries.tagline: The one where the ocean did all the talking.
countries.intro: Proof you don't need an overwater villa budget to see it properly — local islands, a guesthouse, and some of the clearest water I've ever swum in.

places.name: Malé
places.note: A short stopover to reset before the speedboat out — local market, fish harbour, and a rooftop coffee.

places.name: Maafushi (Local Island)
places.note: Bikini beach by day, night snorkeling with reef sharks, and a sandbank picnic that needed zero filter.

logistics.stay: Guesthouse on Maafushi, local island (no resort)
logistics.transport: Public ferry + speedboat transfers between islands
logistics.budget: ~$70/day (excl. flights) — the budget way to do the Maldives

tickets.name: Singapore Airlines — SIN to MLE
tickets.note: Booked as a stopover add-on

tickets.name: Malé → Maafushi speedboat
tickets.note: 30 mins, book a day ahead at the jetty

tickets.name: Maafushi guesthouse
tickets.note: Half the price of a resort, same water

countries.name: India
countries.tagline: A country too big for one trip — this was chapter one.
countries.intro: Rajasthan's forts, Delhi's chaos, and an overnight train that taught me more about the country than any guidebook could.

places.name: Delhi
places.note: Old Delhi by cycle rickshaw, Humayun's Tomb at sunrise, and a street food crawl through Chandni Chowk.

places.name: Jaipur & Jodhpur
places.note: The Pink City's forts, the Blue City's rooftop views, and an overnight train between the two.

places.name: Udaipur
places.note: Lake Pichola at golden hour and a rooftop dinner looking straight at the City Palace.

logistics.stay: Heritage guesthouses in Jaipur & Udaipur, hostel in Delhi
logistics.transport: Hired a car + driver for Rajasthan, overnight train Jaipur–Jodhpur
logistics.best_time: Oct–Mar, before the heat sets in

tickets.name: Jaipur → Jodhpur overnight sleeper
tickets.note: Booked via IRCTC, AC 3-tier

tickets.name: Rajasthan circuit, 6 days
tickets.note: Arranged through the Jaipur guesthouse

tickets.name: Udaipur heritage haveli
